risk_if_not_implemented: Without Compensating Countermeasures, risks may remain unidentified, unowned or unmanaged, leaving decision-makers without a defensible basis for prioritization and treatment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Uncontrolled Internal Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-4), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Vulnerability Remediation Process
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that vulnerabilities are properly identified, tracked and remediated.
compensating_control_1.justification: Vulnerability Remediation Process (VPM-06) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Compensating Countermeasures (RSK-06.2) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Remediation
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to remediate risks to an acceptable level.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Remediation (RSK-17) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Compensating Countermeasures (RSK-06.2) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
